issue_text: Hi, I want to start with my shopping account. Please tell me what promotions are currently active, then check whether the code FALL15SAVE would work with my current cart. After that, confirm the full details of what you found, not just a brief summary.
summary: A 16-turn cross-domain session touching shopping, airline, retail, and travel skills for several users. T1–T2 fetch active promotions and test FALL15SAVE (expired). T3–T6 review a household member's airline reservation D3A184 (Olivia Bennett), explain baggage policy, and add a paid bag. T7–T8 book a brand-new one-way flight for Megan Carter via direct SQL (working around a Pydantic loading failure). T9–T10 recap Olivia's booking, search wireless mice, and reconstruct the earlier promo math. T11–T12 attempt a retail exchange that the system rejects on two independent grounds. T13–T15 move to Elena Brooks's travel reservations and cancel hotel HR-68D9. T16 recaps. All four recall probes (T6, T8, T10, T12) are credited: the agent tracks four separate users and their entities across domains without re-asking. Notably, the two sub-goal FAILs under T10 and T12 are not memory errors — the grader expected a successful promo application and a completed exchange, but the agent correctly determined both were impossible (expired code; cross-product exchange with no variants).
